### Data

```{python}
import os
import urllib.request

# Source: https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2020/2020-09-22
BASE_URL = (
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/"
    "main/data/2020/2020-09-22/"
)
RAW_DIR = "../data/raw"
os.makedirs(RAW_DIR, exist_ok=True)

for name in ["members", "expeditions", "peaks"]:
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(f"{BASE_URL}{name}.csv", f"{RAW_DIR}/{name}.csv")
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

members = pd.read_csv(f"{RAW_DIR}/members.csv")
expeditions = pd.read_csv(f"{RAW_DIR}/expeditions.csv")
peaks = pd.read_csv(f"{RAW_DIR}/peaks.csv")

# Columns recorded during or after the climb. These reveal the outcome.
LEAKY_MEMBER_COLS = [
    "highpoint_metres", "died", "death_cause", "death_height_metres",
    "injured", "injury_type", "injury_height_metres",
    "oxygen_used",  # whether this member actually used oxygen
]

expedition_info = (
    expeditions[["expedition_id", "year", "members", "hired_staff", "oxygen_used"]]
    .rename(columns={"members": "team_size", "oxygen_used": "expedition_oxygen"})
)
peak_info = peaks[["peak_id", "height_metres"]].rename(
    columns={"height_metres": "peak_height_m"}
)

himalaya = (
    members
    .drop(columns=LEAKY_MEMBER_COLS)
    .drop_duplicates(subset=["expedition_id", "member_id"])
    .merge(expedition_info, on=["expedition_id", "year"], how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    .merge(peak_info, on="peak_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    .query("year >= 1990 and season != 'Unknown'")
)

FEATURES = [
    "year", "season", "sex", "age", "citizenship", "expedition_role",
    "hired", "solo", "team_size", "hired_staff", "expedition_oxygen",
    "peak_height_m",
]
TARGET = "success"

himalaya = himalaya[["expedition_id", "peak_name"] + FEATURES + [TARGET]]

PROCESSED_DIR = "../data/processed"
os.makedirs(PROCESSED_DIR, exist_ok=True)
himalaya.to_csv(f"{PROCESSED_DIR}/himalaya_clean.csv", index=False)
```
```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

splitter = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.3, random_state=522)
train_idx, test_idx = next(splitter.split(himalaya, groups=himalaya["expedition_id"]))
train_df = himalaya.iloc[train_idx]
test_df = himalaya.iloc[test_idx]

# No expedition should appear in both sets
assert set(train_df["expedition_id"]).isdisjoint(test_df["expedition_id"])

train_df.to_csv(f"{PROCESSED_DIR}/himalaya_train.csv", index=False)
test_df.to_csv(f"{PROCESSED_DIR}/himalaya_test.csv", index=False)
```
